serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Freshly baked bread just melts in my mouth, the edges are crispy, but inside is spongy and sweet. 
Chicken has a nice, golden colored crust. The perfect amount of salt brings the best from the meat.
Tomato sauce has some large chunks, making the sandwich taste a little different with every bite. 
What a way to start a day…
You: This is amazing. I feel like I received some powerup from eating it!
Bot: I’m glad you like it so much! 
You: It really tasted like heaven.
